title: Tata Sons designated Upper-Layer NBFC (NBFC-UL) by RBI
summary: Tata Sons joins RBI's NBFC-UL list, taking the count to 17 — with 4 govt-owned PSU firms entering for the first time.

blocks.content: Tata Sons joins RBI's NBFC-UL list, taking the count to 17 — with 4 govt-owned PSU firms entering for the first time.

items: **17 NBFCs** now in Upper Layer (up from 15); once classified, enhanced regulation applies ≥5 years even if criteria later unmet
4 PSU firms joined for 1st time: **REC, PFC, IRFC, HUDCO**

PNB Housing Finance & Sammaan Capital: sources conflict — File A states they "dropped out"; File B states they "remain in UL under the 5-year rule." Flagging as a genuine cross-source discrepancy — verify against RBI's official list before the exam if this becomes testable.
Revised norms (Jun 2026): NBFCs with assets >₹1 trillion → Upper Layer, must list within 3 years; Tata Sons standalone assets >₹2 trillion (Mar 2026)
NBFC layers: Base (<₹1,000 cr) → Middle (≥₹1,000 cr) → Upper (≥₹1 lakh cr) → Top (no fixed limit)

blocks.content: 🎯 Exam Angle → 🔥 HIGH — Tata Sons as NBFC-UL + 17-count + mandatory 3-yr listing window — headline "first."
